activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and washing face
Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast
Getting dressed and checking phone for community program messages and news
Setting up the home workspace at the desk, reviewing the calendar and program to-do list
Working on the computer: answering emails, drafting grant reports and joining video calls
Taking a short break, stretching and resting

Cooking and eating dinner, then cleaning up
Leisure time watching TV and browsing on the phone
Reading and winding down on the phone before sleep
